text:
Your bank will never ask you to tap your card on your phone.

Dutch police say AI voiced fake bank calls got 170 people to install an app and hold their card to their phone. The app copied the card. About €380,000 was drained in three weeks.

If a "bank" calls you: hang up and call the number on the back of your card. Never install an app or tap your card for a caller.

Send this to the person in your family who always picks up. Have you gotten a call like this?
